E2120

`--deep-checks={scope}` names no package, module, type or function of this program.

What

`--deep-checks={scope}` names no package, module, type or function of this program.

Why

A scope keeps the deep checks of the declarations it names, and this one names none, so it would keep nothing.

Fix

Drop it, or name a scope that holds a deep check: {holders}.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E2120: tests/ui/deep_checks_unknown_scope.stderr.

Error [jet.DeepCheckScopeUnknown]: `--deep-checks=tree::nowhere` names no package, module, type or function of this program.
 Why: A scope keeps the deep checks of the declarations it names, and this one names none, so it would keep nothing.
 Fix: Drop it, or name a scope that holds a deep check: no declaration of this program holds one.
